pairs: Cumque venissent David et viri ejus in Siceleg die tertia,
And when David and his men had arrived at Ziklag on the third day,
Amalecitæ impetum fecerant ex parte australi in Siceleg,
the Amalekites had made an attack on the south side against Ziklag.
Et captivas duxerant mulieres ex ea,
And they had led the women in it away as captives,
from the small to the great.
And they had not killed anyone,
but they led them away with them.
And then they traveled on their journey.
Cum ergo venissent David et viri ejus ad civitatem,
Therefore, when David and his men had arrived at the city,
and had found it burned with fire,
et uxores suas, et filios suos et filias, ductas esse captivas,
and that their wives and their sons and daughters had been led away as captives,
levaverunt David et populus qui erat cum eo voces suas,
David and the people who were with him lifted up their voices.
et planxerunt donec deficerent in eis lacrimæ.
And they mourned until the tears in them failed.
Siquidem et duæ uxores David captivæ ductæ fuerant,
For indeed, the two wives of David also had been led away as captives:
and Abigail, the wife of Nabal of Carmel.
And the people were willing to stone him,
quia amara erat anima uniuscujusque viri super filiis suis et filiabus:
because the soul of every man was bitter over his sons and daughters.
confortatus est autem David in Domino Deo suo.
But David was strengthened by the Lord his God.
Et ait ad Abiathar sacerdotem filium Achimelech:
And he said to the priest Abiathar, the son of Ahimelech,
Et applicavit Abiathar ephod ad David.
And Abiathar brought the ephod to David.
And the Lord said to him:
you will overtake them and find the prey.”
ipse et sexcenti viri qui erant cum eo,
he and the six hundred men who were with him,
et venerunt usque ad torrentem Besor:
and they arrived as far as the torrent Besor.
And certain ones, being weary, stayed there.
Persecutus est autem David ipse, et quadringenti viri:
But David pursued, he and four hundred men.
qui lassi transire non poterant torrentem Besor.
being weary, were not able to cross the torrent Besor.
Et invenerunt virum ægyptium in agro,
And they found an Egyptian man in the field,
and they led him to David.
And they gave him bread, so that he might eat, and water,
and also a section of a mass of dried figs,
and two clusters of dried grapes.
For he had not eaten bread,
for three days and three nights.
And so David said to him:
“I am a young man of Egypt,
the servant of an Amalekite man.
because I began to be sick the day before yesterday.
Siquidem nos erupimus ad australem plagam Cerethi,
For indeed, we broke forth to the southern side of Cherethi,
and to the south of Caleb,
and we burned Ziklag with fire.”
Potes me ducere ad cuneum istum?
“Are you able to lead me to this battle line?”
Jura mihi per Deum quod non occidas me,
“Swear to me by God that you will not kill me,
et non tradas me in manus domini mei,
and that you will not deliver me into the hands of my lord,
et ego ducam te ad cuneum istum.
and I will lead you to this battle line.”
And when he had led him,
ecce illi discumbebant super faciem universæ terræ comedentes
they were stretched out on the face of the land everywhere,
as if it were a feast day,
et spoliis quæ ceperant de terra Philisthiim
because of all the prey and spoils that they had taken from the land of the Philistines,
and from the land of Judah.
Et percussit eos David a vespere usque ad vesperam alterius diei,
And David struck them down from evening until the evening of the next day.
et non evasit ex eis quisquam,
And no one among them escaped,
who had climbed on camels and fled.
Eruit ergo David omnia quæ tulerant Amalecitæ,
Therefore, David rescued all that the Amalekites had taken,
and he rescued his two wives.
Nec defuit quidquam a parvo usque ad magnum,
And nothing was missing, from small even to great,
tam de filiis quam de filiabus,
among the sons and daughters, and among the spoils,
et de spoliis, et quæcumque rapuerant:
and among everything whatsoever that they had seized.
Et tulit universos greges et armenta,
And he took all the flocks and the herds,
and he drove them before his face.
Venit autem David ad ducentos viros qui lassi substiterant,
Then David arrived at the two hundred men, who, being weary,
had stayed, for they had not been able to follow David,
et residere eos jusserat in torrente Besor:
and he had ordered them to remain at the torrent Besor.
qui egressi sunt obviam David et populo qui erat cum eo.
And they went out to meet David, and the people who were with him.
Then David, drawing near to the people,
And all the wicked and iniquitous men,
et iniquus de viris qui ierant cum David,
out of the men who had gone with David,
non dabimus eis quidquam de præda quam eruimus:
“Since they did not go with us,
we will not give to them anything from the prey that we have rescued.
But let his wife and children be enough for each of them;
Dixit autem David: Non sic facietis,
But David said: “You shall not do this,
de his quæ tradidit nobis Dominus,
with these things that the Lord has delivered to us,
et dedit latrunculos qui eruperant adversum nos, in manus nostras:
and he has given into our hands the robbers who broke out among us.
nec audiet vos quisquam super sermone hoc:
And so, let no one heed you over these words.
æqua enim pars erit descendentis ad prælium,
But equal shall be the portion of him who descended to the battle,
and of him who remained with the supplies,
and they will divide it alike.”
Et factum est hoc ex die illa et deinceps,
And this has been done from that day and thereafter.
And it was established as a statute,
et quasi lex in Israël usque in diem hanc.
and as if a law, in Israel even to this day.
et misit dona de præda senioribus Juda proximis suis,
and he sent gifts from the prey to the elders of Judah, his neighbors,
Accipite benedictionem de præda hostium Domini:
“Receive a blessing from the prey of the enemies of the Lord,”
to those who were in Bethel,
et qui in Ramoth ad meridiem,
and who were in Ramoth toward the south,
and who were in the cities of Jerahmeel,
and who were in the cities of Keni,
and who were at the lake of Ashan,
et reliquis qui erant in his locis in quibus commoratus fuerat David,
and to the remainder who were in those places where David had stayed,
